name: looksift
description: Choose numbered style, palette, or outfit references on Looksift, then use them for prompts and images with the host's image tool.

interface.longDescription: Choose a numbered style, palette or outfit reference on Looksift and bring it to your Agent. Any one kind is enough. A selected style has two independent Qwen/GPT reference versions; outfit edits preserve the supplied person's identity and pose. A capable client generates images. Without drawing or the required reference-image inputs, the Agent delivers full prompts, real reference download links, input order and brief usage steps. The remote MCP provides the official prompt templates and public reference data; it needs no login and does not generate images. Responses follow your language and prompt-only never draws. Pose, action, expression, monster and private collections are outside this version.
defaultPrompt: How do I use Looksift? Show me where to choose style, palette, or outfit references.
Use Looksift outfit A032 to change the clothing in my attached person image, keeping their identity and pose.
Use Looksift style 47 for a seaside bookshop. Write only the prompts in my language; do not generate images.
